description: Fetch a page and extract content in any format — text, markdown, html, links, or cookies. Optionally evaluate JavaScript. One-shot: no session needed.

cookies.description: Optional cookies to inject before navigation. Array of {name, value, domain?, path?, ...}

eval.description: Optional JavaScript expression to evaluate. Combined with format output.

format.description: Output format: text (plain, default), markdown (clean markdown), html (raw HTML), links (all hrefs), cookies (with domain/path/expiry), axtree (accessibility tree), layout (viewport dimensions)

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers to send. Object with string key/value pairs.

stealth.description: Accepted for compatibility. Stealth behavior is controlled by the Obscura server.

userAgent.description: Override User-Agent string for this request.

name: browse_page
